{{Quote|A favorite on Naboo and throughout the Chommell sector, slow-cooked in our gamma flux broiler with space-carrots, Ojomian onions, Anzati snot garlic, and Deltron spice wine.|The Dex's Diner menu's description of Shaak pot roast|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''Anzati snot garlic''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Garlic/Legends|garlic]] used in cooking. One dish in which the garlic was used was known as [[Shaak pot roast]], which was served in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. On the planet [[Monsolar/Legends|Monsolar]], the bulb was also used as part of a folk remedy for ending infestation by a [[syrox]] [[Parasite/Legends|parasite]]. When the Monsolar native [[Waleed Nagma]] suffered such an infestation, he had a bulb [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] into the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] known as [[Cog Hive Seven]], where he was [[Prisoner/Legends|incarcerated]]. He successfully used it to draw out the syrox from within him.

==Biology and appearance==
[[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] snot [[Garlic/Legends|garlic]] was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of garlic<ref name="DaD" /> that grew in cloves.<ref name="TSR" />

==History==
{{Quote|Back on Monsolar, we have an old folk remedy for those who've been infected. Go to sleep with a bulb of snot garlic on your pillow. They say the syrox is attracted to the smell. It comes crawling out on its own.|Waleed Nagma describes a folk remedy for syrox infestation|<ref name="TSR" />}}
[[File:Zero.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Zero smuggled a bulb of Anzati snot garlic into the Cog Hive Seven prison.]]
On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Monsolar/Legends|Monsolar]], a folk remedy using snot garlic developed as a method of curing infestation by [[Parasite/Legends|parasites]] known as [[syrox]]. If an individual within whom a syrox was growing placed the snot garlic on their [[Pillow/Legends|pillow]] before going to [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]], then the smell would draw the creature out through the [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] of the sufferer. For this reason, [[Waleed Nagma]], a native of Monsolar, had a bulb of snot garlic [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] into the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Cog Hive Seven]] whilst he was an [[Prisoner/Legends|inmate]] there. Nagma, who had a syrox growing inside him, had fellow inmate [[Dakarai Blirr|Zero]] smuggle in the bulb with the prison's supplies. Nagma then used it as the folk remedy suggested, although the Monsolar native did so only as a last resort, initially attempting to have the parasite removed surgically. The syrox emerged from within Nagma while he was still awake and was then [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Zero.<ref name="TSR" />

Anzati snot garlic was used as an ingredient in [[Shaak pot roast]], along with [[Shaak/Legends|Shaak]] meat, [[Carrot/Legends|space carrots]], [[Ojomian onion]]s, and [[Deltron spice wine]]. The dish was served for 8.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster's]] [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], on the planet of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The diner prepared the dish by slow-cooking it in a [[gamma flux broiler]], and did so<ref name="DaD" /> before the destruction of the establishment in around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> The dish was also a favorite in the [[Lesser Plooriod Cluster/Legends|Lesser Plooriod Cluster]] throughout the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]], including the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="DaD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Anzati snot garlic was first mentioned in the [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]]. The article does not make clear if there is a connection between the garlic<ref name="DaD" /> and the sentient species named the [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]], who are native to the planet [[Anzat/Legends|Anzat]].<ref name="NEGTAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> The garlic then appeared in the short story "[[The Syrox Redemption]]," which was written by [[Joe Schreiber]] and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 146|146th]] issue of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="TSR" /> on [[December 10]], [[2013]].<ref name="Date">[[Star Wars Insider 145|''Star Wars Insider'' 145]]</ref>
